data.content: For Diuron, at how many sites was it detected (defined as `median_concentration > 0`) across all years/quarters?

args.query: Count the distinct sampling sites where the substance Diuron has been detected (median_concentration > 0) in any year-quarter across all available data. Return only the count of unique sites.

data.content:
The results comprise 1 rows:
            
            <data>
            {"unique_site_count":{"0":2525}}
            </data>
            
            Provide the user with a Markdown formatted table of the data and a textual summary.
            <summary>
            {"unique_site_count":{"count":1.0,"mean":2525.0,"std":null,"min":2525.0,"25%":2525.0,"50%":2525.0,"75%":2525.0,"max":2525.0}}
            </summary>
            
            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE s.Name = 'Diuron' AND r.median_concentration > 0
RETURN count(DISTINCT l.name) AS unique_site_count

            ```
            
            Always provide the Zenodo link `https://zenodo.org/records/14616124` of the docker container holding
            the full Neo4j graph database where the user can access the complete result with the cypher query.
data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
Diuron was detected at 2,525 unique sampling sites across all years/quarters (defined as median_concentration > 0).

Cypher query used:
MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE s.Name = 'Diuron' AND r.median_concentration > 0
RETURN count(DISTINCT l.name) AS unique_site_count

You can access and run this query against the full Neo4j graph database here: https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
